info.name: IT Help Desk API
info.description:
Walks the help-desk workflow: raising tickets, the urgency-ordered queue and SLA state, assignment, the one-step status flow (closed is final), comments with agent-only internal notes, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8114). Repeatable: it registers a fresh employee and creates uniquely titled tickets each run.

item.name: Register a fresh employee for this run
Categories and priorities with SLA hours

exec: pm.test("Four priorities, critical is 4 hours", () => { const m = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(m.priorities.length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(m.priorities.find(p => p.name == "CRITICAL").slaHours).to.eql(4); });

pm.test("Open, with a reference and an 8 hour deadline", () => { pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("OPEN"); pm.expect(t.number).to.match(/^HD-\d+$/); pm.expect(t.slaState).to.eql("ON_TRACK"); pm.expect(t.assigneeUsername).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Another employee does not see them
Another employee cannot open my ticket

exec: pm.test("With an empty conversation", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.ticket.title).to.include("Postman Ticket"); pm.expect(d.comments).to.eql([]); });

item.name: The ticket is in the unassigned queue

exec: pm.test("Both, most urgent (high) first", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].priority).to.eql("HIGH"); });
pm.test("Assigned, still open", () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.assigneeUsername).to.eql("sanjay.rao"); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("OPEN"); });

item.name: Put it back in the queue
The agents list shows their load
Skipping to resolved is a conflict

exec: pm.test("In progress and owned by the agent", () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("IN_PROGRESS"); pm.expect(t.assigneeUsername).to.eql("support"); });

item.name: Starting it again is a conflict
Work in progress cannot be left without an owner

exec: pm.test("Resolved within the SLA", () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("RESOLVED"); pm.expect(t.resolution).to.eql("Replaced the faulty cable"); pm.expect(t.slaState).to.eql("MET"); pm.expect(t.allowedNext).to.eql(["CLOSED", "IN_PROGRESS"]); });

item.name: A resolved ticket can go back to in progress

exec: pm.test("Back in progress, resolved time cleared", () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("IN_PROGRESS"); pm.expect(t.resolvedAt).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Closed, nothing further allowed", () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("CLOSED"); pm.expect(t.allowedNext).to.eql([]); });

item.name: A closed ticket cannot be reopened
A closed ticket cannot be reassigned
An employee cannot write internal notes
The agent adds an internal note
The employee sees two messages, not the note

exec: pm.test("No internal notes", () => { const c = pm.response.json().comments; pm.expect(c.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(c.some(x => x.internal)).to.be.false; });
pm.test("Three, one internal", () => { const c = pm.response.json().comments; pm.expect(c.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(c.filter(x => x.internal).length).to.eql(1); });

item.name: A closed ticket takes no comments
Agent has no personal ticket list
